name: Fanuel
source:
The angel of death who revived Itaru at the beginning of the game.
She has an androgynous look, with a cuteness that's neither entirely masculine or feminine. But her speech and behavior are downright awful.
Most of what comes out of her mouth is abuse or sarcasm, and she seems to look down on everyone.
Implanting a memory of herself as a distant relative of Itaru, she lives as a freeloader in his house.
